website.description: The website as given in the input.

siteName.description: The site's own name (og:site_name), when it states one.

contactPageUrl.description: The best contact page found, or null.

contactPageMethod.description: link: linked from the homepage. guess: found at /contact or a similar usual address. homepage: the contact section or form is on the homepage itself. null: none found.

contactPageKind.description: contact: a contact page. support: a support or help page. about: an about page or legal notice, the weakest fallback.

hasContactForm.description: A form for writing a message is in the contact page's HTML. null: the contact page was linked but not read. Forms drawn by JavaScript after loading are not seen.

contactFormType.description: html: a form in the page. embed: a form service loaded into the page (HubSpot, Typeform, Jotform, Google Forms, Tally, Paperform...).

socialProfiles.description: One cleaned profile address per network, or null. LinkedIn: company, school and showcase pages only, never personal profiles.

emails.description: Role-based addresses only (info@, sales@, support@...), the site's own domain first. At most 20.

otherEmailsOmitted.description: How many other addresses were seen and deliberately not returned, because their name part is not on the list of role names.

pagesFetched.description: Pages of this website that were read.

checkedAt.description: When the website was read, ISO 8601 UTC.
